notes: The Cafe hot-water door board, Keurig parts and door control board are Cafe-only. Model year H = 2014.

gaps: The guide does not say which models get the variable-speed or single-speed compressor.
Neither the compressor nor a start relay is claimed for this model.
The page 9 static-pressure table hints at the type but does not state it for this model.
Of the parts claimed, only the freezer evaporator thermistor has a GE part number in the guide.
method: French-door bottom-freezer with dual evaporators and a refrigerant 3-way valve.

Source: GE Appliances Technical Service Guide 31-9250 (April 2016), '2014-2015 GE, Adora, Cafe & Profile French Door Refrigerators', which covers GFE28HSH with GFE26GGH/GSH, GFE28HGH/HMH, GYE22KMH/KSH and the Cafe, Adora and Profile models.
Read as text from the PDF (Internet Archive) on 2026-11-12, with page 9 also viewed as an image because its table headings are in an encoded font.
Page numbers are the printed guide pages.

Most component facts in the guide are stated for all covered models; the guide's technical-data column for GFE26/DFE28/GFE28/GFE27/PFH28 gives an R134a charge of 5.50 oz and a 9.5 A rating at 115 VAC 60 Hz.

The guide describes both a variable-speed inverter compressor (3-phase, 80-240 VAC, 55-130 Hz, 60-180 W, no relay or capacitor) and a single-speed reciprocating compressor with relay, overload and run capacitor (specs in the unit's mini-manual).

comps.spec: Freezer evaporator fan on the evaporator cover, three speeds with RPM feedback to the control, 2200-2500 rpm; box-type fan (pp. 57, 73)
Fresh food evaporator fan in a recess at the bottom of the fresh food air duct, three speeds with RPM feedback, 1500-4100 rpm (p. 71)
Ice box fan at the top left rear of the freezer above the evaporator, three speeds with RPM feedback, 1500-2300 rpm (p. 75)
Condenser fan in the machine compartment between the 3-way valve and the condenser, 1000-2100 rpm with RPM feedback (p. 77)
Freezer defrost heater: 420 W single-tube glass-enclosed radiant heater at the bottom of the evaporator, about 32 ohms (p. 74)
Fresh food defrost heater: single-tube glass-enclosed radiant heater on the fresh food evaporator, about 31 ohms (p. 70)
Fresh food and freezer overtemperature (defrost) thermostats clipped to the evaporator tubing, open at about 140 F and close at about 110 F (pp. 9, 70, 74)

Thermistors, 16.3 kOhm at 32 F: fresh food air thermistor in the ceiling, freezer air thermistor on the right wall, fresh food and freezer evaporator thermistors on the evaporator inlet tubes; freezer evaporator thermistor sold separately as WR55X10025 (pp. 9, 68, 70, 75)

Water valves: isolation valve in the machine compartment right of the condenser, coil about 390 ohms; main water valve inside the left fresh food door feeding icemaker and dispenser, each coil about 400 ohms, with a flowmeter on Precise Fill/Auto Fill models (p. 99)

Refrigerant 3-way valve with a removable coil in the machine compartment between the compressor and the condenser fan; four positions: both evaporators in series, freezer evaporator only, both via their own capillary tubes (not used for cooling on these models), and closed (pp. 78-79)
Pin-Point LED lighting: 5 or 7 LEDs in the fresh food compartment and 1 or 2 in the bottom of the left fresh food door for the freezer, wired in series, each on a 2-pin connector (p. 63)
Magnetic gaskets on the fresh food doors and freezer drawer, held by a barbed edge in a retainer channel (p. 63)

Main control board in a covered recess in the back of the cabinet, eleven wire harnesses; its listed outputs (some or all, by model) include compressor, 3-way valve, variable-speed fan control with RPM feedback, defrost, icemaker and isolation water valves and LED lighting (pp. 102-103)

Sealed system: compressor, drain pan loop, condenser coil and loop, drier, 3-way valve, fresh food (red) and freezer (blue) capillary tubes, two evaporators, accumulator, suction line; R134a, 5.50 oz charge for the GFE28 column (pp. 9, 54, 79)
